controls.title: Logical Access Controls and Authentication
controls.description: The entity restricts logical access to registered users via strong authentication and RBAC.
controls.remediation_guidance: Enforce Cognito TOTP MFA and verify all protected endpoints validate JWT signatures.

controls.title: Boundary Protection and Perimeter Defense
controls.description: Logical boundaries prevent unauthorized network access and enforce TLS 1.3.
controls.remediation_guidance: Ensure all public-facing services terminate TLS 1.3 with strict cipher suites.

controls.title: Unauthorized Software & Change Management
controls.description: Infrastructure changes and deployments are managed via version-controlled IaC and automated testing.
controls.remediation_guidance: Enforce branch protection rules and mandatory peer reviews on Terraform modules.

controls.title: Vulnerability Detection and Continuous Monitoring
controls.description: Continuous automated vulnerability scanning and threat detection identify emerging attack vectors.
controls.remediation_guidance: Enable GuardDuty Runtime and S3 Malware Protection across active AWS regions.

controls.title: Security Event Monitoring and Incident Alerting
controls.description: System anomalies and unauthorized access attempts are logged and trigger automated alarms.
controls.remediation_guidance: Verify multi-region CloudTrail logging is enabled with log file validation.

controls.title: Access Control & Least Privilege
controls.description: Access rights to assets and information are provisioned according to least privilege and role requirements.
controls.remediation_guidance: Audit IAM roles quarterly and delete unused credentials with 90+ days inactivity.

controls.title: Protection Against Malware & Malicious Ingestion
controls.description: Measures are implemented to prevent and detect malware in incoming streaming transactions and objects.
controls.remediation_guidance: Ensure all uploaded file evidence in S3 undergoes GuardDuty automated malware scanning.

controls.title: Data Leakage Prevention & Data Lake Isolation
controls.description: Sensitive banking transactions and PII are protected against unauthorized exfiltration.
controls.remediation_guidance: Block all S3 public access and enforce customer-managed KMS keys with annual rotation.

controls.title: Monitoring Activities & Tamper-Evident Logging
controls.description: Networks, systems, and user applications are monitored for anomalous behavior and security events.
controls.remediation_guidance: Verify DynamoDB security audit table has point-in-time recovery and KMS encryption.

controls.title: Cryptographic Controls and Key Management
controls.description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including key management and rotation, are implemented.
controls.remediation_guidance: Ensure KMS CMK automatic annual key rotation is enabled across all storage targets.

findings.title: S3 Bucket Versioning LifeCycle Rule Missing Expiration
findings.description: Bucket 'finguard-data-lake-bronze' retains noncurrent object versions indefinitely.
remediation_steps: Attach S3 Lifecycle transition to archive old versions to S3 Glacier after 90 days.

findings.title: Anomalous API Invocation Outside Normal Business Hours
findings.description: IAM role assumed from unaccustomed IP address outside corporate CIDR.
remediation_steps: Inspect CloudTrail logs for actions performed by this role session.
Revoke active STS credentials if activity is unverified.
